5.speaker: Player
5.text: “Thank you. It's good to be here, Mr. Alvarez.”

6.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
6.text: “Good to have you here. I hear a lot about your successes.”

7.speaker: Player
7.text: “And I hear a lot about your successes as well, Mr. Alvarez.”

9.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
9.text: “I hope you had a nice trip.”

11.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
11.text: “Confidence is a rare quality, Mr. Rayne.”

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I smelled the strong odor of alcohol.

15.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
15.text: “A couple of glasses of the finest Lespian wine is the best way to start any meeting.”

19.speaker: Player
19.text: “You are speaking to a President. Where is your professionalism?”

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: They came back very fast. We took a sip.

27.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
27.text: “So, you are here for the trade deal.”

28.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
28.text: “What was it about again? Can you remind me?”

30.speaker: Player
30.text: “Mr. Alvarez. Are you making fun of me right now?”

31.speaker: Player
31.text: “We want to provide Sordish fishing output in return for Lespian capital.”

41.speaker: Player
41.text: “We want to provide Sordish wheat in return for Lespian capital.”

42.speaker: Player
42.text: “We want to provide Sordish coal in return for Lespian capital.”
42.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Lorren"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Bergia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Agnland"] == true) == false)

43.speaker: Player
43.text: “We want to provide Sordish tungsten in return for Lespian capital.”
43.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Lorren"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Bergia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn04_RegionalInvestment_Agnland"] == true) == false)

45.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
45.text: “I have just been very busy lately.”

46.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
46.text: “You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”

48.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
48.text: “Sorry. I have just been very busy lately.”

49.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
49.text: “So, I don't have any issues with this deal.”

54.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
54.text: “You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: He pulled out a few documents from his briefcase and started inspecting them.

61.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
61.text: “Your decision to defend the border while Smolak committed war crimes diverted all those refugees here.”

62.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
62.text: “Now we have a full-blown refugee crisis in Lespia.”

63.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
63.text: “Which unfortunately means that the price has gone up, Mr. Rayne.”

64.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
64.text: “Your decision to join Smolak in his attack against the unfortunate Bludish population compromised a lot of the Lespian assets in the area.”

65.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
65.text: “This has negatively affected Lespia. Our economy was indirectly hit due to the destruction of manufacturing sites. In particular the oil refineries.”

66.speaker: Player
66.text: “No. The price will stay the same or there won't be any deal.”

67.speaker: Player
67.text: “Tell me what you want, Mr. Alvarez.”

68.speaker: Player
68.text: “Makes sense. I knew this was coming. So what is on the new price tag?”

70.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
70.text: “Just like it was your choice to leave Bludish people alone to fend for themselves.”

71.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
71.text: “Reminds me of Soll in many ways. What was it? Ah yes. The Soll Dam Incident.”

73.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
73.text: “The only thing anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”

75.speaker: Player
75.text: “And how are you planning to get that?”

77.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
77.text: “A lot of oil from Wehlen is passing through Sordland.”

78.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
78.text: “And Sordish Petroleum owns most of the oil trade in Sordland.”

79.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
79.text: “Do you see where I am going with that?”

82.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
82.text: “I want you to sell me Sordish Petroleum or the deal is off.”

83.speaker: Player
83.text: “There is no way I can do that.”

84.speaker: Player
84.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_Removed"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SordishPetroleum"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Studyplace_Deyr_History"] == true) == false)

85.speaker: Player
85.text: “You really are a shrewd man, Mr. Alvarez.”

86.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
86.text: “I will take that as a compliment.”

87.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
87.text: “Then thank you for coming this far to visit Perla.”

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: He got up and started making his way to the door.

89.speaker: Player
89.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Situation_Diplomacy_Lespia_SordishPetroleum"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Studyplace_Deyr_History"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_Removed"] == true)

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: He turned around with a smile and opened his arms.

91.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
91.text: “My favorite phrase in this world. 'I accept.'.”

96.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
96.text: “I think it will contribute nicely to the relationship between Lespia and Sordland.”

97.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
97.text: “I do, however, believe that we can do much more than just trade.”

100.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
100.text: “...Would like to see Sordland in our sphere.”

102.speaker: Player
102.text: “Thank you for the offer but that is not one of our aims for now.”

103.speaker: Player
103.text: “Why would you do that for Sordland? What's in it for you?”

104.speaker: Player
104.text: “That sounds excellent. How do we begin?”

105.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
105.text: “Just the answer I wanted to hear!”

108.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
108.text: “And most importantly, forming a defensive pact against United Contana.”

110.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
110.text: “But where will you stand when United Contana attacks Eastern Merkopa, as it surely will?”

112.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
112.text: “We need to form a defensive pact against United Contana in Eastern Merkopa before it's too late.”

115.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
115.text: “We need to stop them before it's too late.”

116.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
116.text: “Valgsland, those barbarians, are preparing to invade Heljiland on false accusations.”

117.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
117.text: “If Agnolia is first, Sordland will be next.”

118.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
118.text: “I will be frank. Eastern Merkopa's only way to survival is through ATO.”

120.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
120.text: “Will you defend our continent against the blight of communism?”

121.speaker: Player
121.text: “Down with the communists. I am willing to do whatever it takes to protect Sordland.”

122.speaker: Player
122.text: “I think you are exaggerating the threat. I have my doubts about this.”

123.speaker: Player
123.text: “I can't decide without knowing what is in it for me.”

124.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
124.text: “I see that you possess the mind of a man who understands business.”

125.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
125.text: “I offer you an alliance. It will come with a special aid package from me.”

126.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
126.text: “Together we will shield the continent against Malenyev's evil.”

127.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
127.text: “Not to mention that you will have Arcasia's full backing. The most powerful ally you can have in this era.”

128.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
128.text: “I am giving you this option for your country's own good, Mr. Rayne.”

129.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
129.text: “Well said! First, Hegel will fall. Then Malenyev!”

130.speaker: Player
130.text: “I accept. Sordland will be allied to Lespia.” [+2 Government Budget]

131.speaker: Player
131.text: “I have to refuse. I will not drag Sordland into an international conflict.”

132.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
132.text: “I am overjoyed. This is a start to bring our countries closer than ever before.”

134.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
134.text: “Speaking of standing together...I want to talk to you about something.”

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: He clenched his fist and slammed it on the coffee table.

136.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
136.text: “And we need the support of one of the largest players in Eastern Merkopa. Sordland.”

137.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
137.text: “The beautiful country of Sordland is the key to all of this. We need you, Mr. Rayne. We need Sordland.”

138.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
138.text: “You think you are evading the conflict by trying to stay neutral.”

139.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
139.text: “Remember my words when the conflict is at your doorstep, ringing your doorbell, Mr. Rayne.”

142.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
142.text: “You don't know how valuable you are, Mr. Rayne!”

143.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
143.text: “You just saved your country from its demise.”

144.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
144.text: “I will personally talk to Mr. Walker to let him know of this achievement.”

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: We shook hands and he went in for a hug. I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

146.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
146.text: “Don't forget that I gave you a choice.”

147.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
147.text: “I can just say that I hope Sordland doesn't fall into a bad position because of your decision.”

149.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
149.text: “Not to mention the humanitarian implications. We had to do our duty and send aid to those who were displaced as a result.”

150.speaker: Player
150.text: “Take care of your own country's issues first, Mr. Alvarez.”

151.speaker: Player
151.text: “I would recommend you not to badmouth Colonel Soll.”

152.speaker: Player
152.text: “I had to make a hard decision and this is the result of it.”

153.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
153.text: “Not every hard decision is right, Mr. Rayne.”

154.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
154.text: “I am doing exactly that right now.”

155.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
155.text: “My apologies. I never took you for a Sollist.”

156.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
156.text: “Before you make your final decision, let me tell you about my offer.”

157.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
157.text: “I want the only thing that anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”

160.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
160.text: “I'm afraid I have to leave now to attend to other matters.”

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: He smiled and left the room.

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: He left the room and an assistant arrived to escort me.

184.speaker: Player
184.text: “Our energy protection laws don't allow such actions. I can't comply Mr. Alvarez.”

185.speaker: Player
185.text: “Shrewd but not investigative enough. The Energy Protection Act doesn't allow such a transaction.”
